name: WeightedAverageNode
label: Weighted Average
description: Adds a column containing the weighted average of a value column, using a separate weights column. Results can be per group or whole-table.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute the weighted average for.

fields.name: WeightsColumn
fields.label: Weights Column
fields.description: The numeric column holding the weights.

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns to group by. Leave empty to use the whole table.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the result column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_WeightedAvg'.
